svg.aria-label: Better Fullstack. A terminal shows the CLI banner and runs bun create better-fullstack with one --part flag per stack part. A rotating ASCII stack prints one layer for each part: a database, a backend, a frontend and a mobile app from different languages, written as one project.

g.text: One project from parts in any language.
